title: Discounted Folk Theorem
body_html:
Discounted Folk Theorem

Let $E_\lambda$ be the set of Nash equilibrium payoffs of the discounted repeated game. If either there are two players or there exists a feasible individually rational payoff that is strictly above every player's minmax level, then $$ E_\lambda\to E \quad\text{as }\lambda\to 0 $$ in Hausdorff distance.

MFoGT emphasizes that the stated hypotheses matter: without them, convergence can fail in games with three or more players.

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 8, Thm. 8.5.2] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Hausdorff convergence of discounted equilibrium payoffs under MFoGT hypotheses.
